quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab 8-K: the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period for the pending Iridium acquisition expired at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on August 12, 2026; Rocket Lab filed its Form S-4 registration statement for the Iridium acquisition (not yet effective), and on August 10, 2026 Rocket Lab and Iridium filed FCC applications seeking consent to transfer control of Iridium's licenses and authorizations to Rocket Lab. CEO Peter Beck: these are 'all major steps for us in the execution timeline for the Iridium acquisition.'
quarterly_data.figure: HSR expired August 12, 2026; FCC applications filed August 10, 2026
